The token opens the MCP server only: not the pages or the API of Cellar, and never the admin (backups, restore, imports, access code).

admin.upgrade.origin_not_applied: ORIGIN is set but not applied, because Cellar was not started with node server.js: every save, import, upload or delete from the browser may be refused with 403 (forbidden). Start Cellar with node server.js.
admin.session_timeout_value: Sessions last {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
admin.barcodes_manual: Entered by hand: automatic generation is off.
admin.access_code_description: The code asked before any change to the cellar and before opening this page.
admin.safety_backup_first: The current database and images are backed up first. The browser then downloads that backup, which also stays in the list of backups.
admin.safety_import_checked: The export is checked before anything is replaced: if the import fails, nothing changes.
admin.backup_settings_description: Automatic backups protect your data at regular intervals. Manual backups are kept apart from them.
admin.backup_interval_help: How often an automatic backup is made (1 to 168 hours).
admin.keep_backup_count_help: The oldest automatic backups are deleted beyond this number (1 to 50).
admin.select_tables_first: Select at least one table to export.
admin.csv_guide_description: Below are the expected table names and column structures for each CSV file. Files are processed in dependency order.
admin.csv_guide_note: Columns ending with "?" are optional. Reference columns (like "countryName", "regionName") should contain the exact names as they appear in your database, not IDs.
admin.access_code_change_description: Change the access code required for editing functionality. Must be at least 4 characters.
admin.barcode_description: Configure how barcodes are generated for wine bottles.
admin.barcode_optional_prefix_descriptio: Optional prefix for all generated barcodes (leave empty for none)
admin.barcode_prefix_shares_numbers: A prefix shares its numbers with the longer prefixes that add digits to it: 1230000002 is a code of both the prefix 123 and an empty prefix, which then goes on at 1230000003.
admin.barcode_start_number_description: Number to start counting from for new bottles
admin.barcode_generation_example: with the prefix "WINE" and the start number 1, the barcodes will be WINE0000001, WINE0000002, etc.
admin.session_timeout_description: Set how long users stay logged in before being automatically logged out, from 1 to 168 hours (1 week). A change applies to the next logins: sessions already open keep their duration. To end the other sessions now, change the access code.
admin.wipe_deletes_all: This will permanently delete ALL wine cellar data including:
admin.wipe_all_wine_types: All wine types, colors, classifications, and formats
admin.wipe_backup_created: Full backup created before wipe (includes "pre-reset" in name)
admin.wipe_backup_downloaded: The backup is downloaded automatically for safety
admin.wipe_cannot_be_undone: This action cannot be undone. Only proceed if you're absolutely certain.
